noRepositoryBody: Open an existing local Git repository to review its changes, history and branches.
changesCount: {count, plural, one {# changed file} other {# changed files}}
stagedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No staged changes} one {# staged change} other {# staged changes}}
unstagedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No unstaged changes} one {# unstaged change} other {# unstaged changes}}
untrackedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No untracked files} one {# untracked file} other {# untracked files}}
errorGitMissing: Git was not found. Install Git (for example with xcode-select --install) and try again.
errorNotDirectory: Choose a folder, not a file.
errorNoAccess: GitOwl cannot read that folder. Check its permissions.
errorNotRepository: That folder is not inside a Git repository.
errorBareRepository: That is a bare repository without a working tree. Open a working copy instead.
errorGitFailed: Git could not complete the operation.
errorRepositoryClosed: That repository is no longer open.
errorStateChanged: The repository changed since it was last read. GitOwl refreshed it; review and try again.
openToReview: Open a repository to review its changes.
cleanBody: There are no staged, unstaged or untracked changes.
addRepositoriesSkipped: {count, plural, one {# folder is not a Git repository and was not added} other {# folders are not Git repositories and were not added}}
draftKept: Your unfinished commit message is kept.
selectFile: Select a file to see its diff.
binaryBody: Git treats this file as binary, so there is no text diff. GitOwl does not compare images or other binary content.
tooLargeBody: This diff is over 4 MB, so GitOwl does not show it. Review it with git diff.
submoduleBody: This is a submodule or another repository inside this one. Open it on its own to review its changes.
conflictBody: This file has merge conflicts. Resolving conflicts is not part of GitOwl yet; resolve them with Git or your editor.
noTextBody: Only the file's mode changed, or the file is empty.
errorCommitPushNoTarget: GitOwl could not tell where to push this branch, so nothing was committed. Fetch, or publish the branch first, then try again.
errorCommitPushStale: The branch moved since this commit, so its push was not retried. GitOwl read the repository again; review it and decide what to push.
commitBStaged: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing staged} one {# file staged} other {# files staged}}
errorNothingStaged: Stage at least one file before committing.
errorEmptyMessage: Write a commit message before committing.
errorIdentityMissing: Git does not know who you are. Set your name and email with git config --global user.name "Your Name" and git config --global user.email "you@example.com", then commit again. Your message is kept.
errorIdentityNameMissing: Enter a name. The email can stay empty.
errorInvalidIdentity: A name or email cannot contain <, > or line breaks.
identityBody: Commits in this repository record this name and email. GitOwl saves them in this repository only, unless you tick the box below to change your global Git settings.
identitySourceGlobal: Taken from your Git settings. Saving copies them into this repository.
identitySourceNone: Git has no name or email yet.
settingsCommitIdentityHint: Show the name and email this repository's commits record in the commit panel, and set them there.
noHistoryBody: This repository has no commits. Stage files and commit to start its history.
selectCommit: Select a commit to see its message and files.
baseEmptyTree: Initial commit, compared with an empty tree
baseFirstParent: Merge commit, compared with first parent {hash}
noFilesInCommit: This commit changes no files compared with its base.
checkoutBody: GitOwl will leave the current branch and check out {hash} ({subject}) directly. HEAD becomes detached: new commits belong to no branch until you create one. Your current branch and its commits are not changed.
checkoutReturnNoBranches: No local branches to return to.
revertOntoBranch: A new commit that undoes the selected commit is added to {branch}.
revertBrowseNote: You are browsing {browsed}, but the reverse commit is written to the current branch {branch}.
revertBody: This adds a normal commit; it does not rewrite history. If it conflicts, GitOwl keeps the revert in progress so you can abort it.
revertInProgress: Reverting {hash} · {count, plural, one {# conflicted file} other {# conflicted files}}
revertResolveHint: Edit {path} to remove the conflict markers, then mark it resolved.
revertContinueDisabled: Resolve every conflict before continuing the revert.
errorRevertDetached: HEAD is not on a branch, so there is no branch to add the reverse commit to.
errorRevertUnborn: This branch has no commits yet.
errorRevertDirty: Revert needs a clean working tree. Commit, discard or move the changes and untracked files first.
errorRevertInProgress: A revert is in progress. Abort it first.
errorRevertMerge: Reverting a merge commit is not supported.
errorRevertNotFound: That commit was not found in this repository.
errorRevertConflicts: Resolve the conflicts before continuing the revert.
filesChanged: {count, plural, one {# file changed} other {# files changed}}
browseBranchGone: The branch you were browsing is gone. Showing the current branch again.
branchesUnborn: {branch} has no commits yet. Create branches after the first commit.
branchesDetached: HEAD is detached at {hash}. Create a branch to keep work made here, or switch to a branch.
upstreamEven: Up to date with {upstream} as last fetched
deleteBranchBody: GitOwl deletes only branches whose commits are already merged. Git refuses an unmerged branch, and GitOwl never forces it.
deleteTagBody: GitOwl deletes only the local tag. A copy of the tag on a remote stays there.
deleteTagRemoteBody: GitOwl deletes the tag on the remote first, then the local tag. If the remote refuses, the local tag stays.
errorInvalidBranchName: That is not a valid branch name. Avoid spaces, "..", a leading "-" and characters such as ~ ^ : ? * [.
errorBranchExists: A branch with that name already exists.
errorBranchNotFound: That branch no longer exists. GitOwl refreshed the list.
errorNoCommitsForBranch: Make the first commit before creating branches.
errorSwitchBlocked: Git did not switch branches because local changes would be overwritten. Your changes are kept; commit them or move them aside, then switch again.
errorDeleteCurrent: The current branch cannot be deleted. Switch to another branch first.
errorBranchNotMerged: Git did not delete the branch because its commits are not merged. GitOwl does not force-delete branches.
errorCheckoutStartNotFound: That commit no longer exists, so there is nothing to branch from. GitOwl refreshed; pick another commit.
errorCheckoutNotSwitched: The branch was created, but GitOwl did not switch to it because local changes would be overwritten. Your changes are kept; the branch stays where it was created.
settingsLanguageHint: The language of GitOwl's interface. Commit messages are not translated.
aboutBody: A lightweight macOS Git client for reviewing changes and history, managing local branches and preparing commit messages.
prefsSaveFailed: Could not save preferences. Your choice applies until GitOwl quits.
aiPrivacy: GitOwl sends staged changes to this service only when you choose Generate Draft, Regenerate or Retry. Preview what's sent in Draft Options shows exactly what would be sent, without sending it.
aiBaseURLHint: An OpenAI-compatible API base. GitOwl posts to <URL>/chat/completions. Use https, or http only for a service on this Mac.
aiKeyHint: Kept in the macOS Keychain, never in GitOwl's preference file or logs. Optional for a service on this Mac (localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1): without a key, GitOwl sends no Authorization header.
aiKeySaved: A key is saved in the Keychain.
aiPromptHint: Your instructions for format and style. They take precedence over GitOwl's defaults. Leave empty to follow the repository's recent commits.
aiPromptPlaceholder: For example: Use Conventional Commits, such as feat(parser): add …
draftLanguageHint: The language of generated commit messages, separate from the interface language.
draftNeedsStaged: Stage files to generate a draft from them.
draftReady: A draft is ready. Your message stays until you replace it.
draftStale: The staged changes changed while this draft was written, so it may not describe what will be committed. Regenerate, or review it before using it.
draftStyleDefault: GitOwl default: a concise subject starting with a verb
draftStyleHistory: {count, plural, one {Matches # recent commit} other {Matches # recent commits}}
previewKeySaved: From the Keychain, sent in the Authorization header
previewFilesValue: {count, plural, one {# staged file} other {# staged files}}, {size} KB in total
previewNote: This is the complete request Generate Draft would send now; viewing it sends nothing. Generate Draft reads the staged changes again when chosen. Unstaged and untracked changes are not included. Nothing is committed until you choose Commit.
errorKeychain: GitOwl could not use the Keychain.
errorAINotConfigured: Set the service URL and model in AI Settings, and an API key unless the service runs on this Mac.
errorAIInvalidURL: The service URL is not valid. Use https://…, or http:// only for a service on this Mac.
errorAIUnauthorized: The service rejected the request's authentication. Check the API key in AI Settings; a service on this Mac may need one too. Your message is kept.
errorAIRateLimited: The service is limiting requests. Wait a moment and retry. Your message is kept.
errorAITooLarge: The service says the request is too large for this model. Set the model context in AI Settings to what the model supports, or unstage some files. GitOwl did not retry. Your message is kept.
errorAITimeout: The service did not answer within 60 seconds. Retry, or check the service. Your message is kept.
errorAINetwork: GitOwl could not reach the service. Check the URL and your connection. Your message is kept.
errorAIBadResponse: The service answered with something that is not a chat completion. Check the URL and model. Your message is kept.
errorAIServiceError: The service reported an error. Your message is kept.
aiKeyNotNeeded: No key saved. Not needed for this service on this Mac unless it asks for one.
previewKeyNone: None: a service on this Mac, sent without an Authorization header
stageAllHint: Stage every change in this worktree, including new files that are not ignored. Conflicts and nested repositories are skipped.
unstageAllHint: Remove every change from the next commit. Files keep their content.
errorNothingToStage: Nothing left to stage. GitOwl does not stage conflicts or nested repositories.
errorUnstageAllConflicts: Unstage All is unavailable while conflicts are unresolved, because it would discard them. Resolve them with Git or your editor first.
bulkSkipped: {count, plural, one {# change was not staged} other {# changes were not staged}}: conflicts and nested repositories are left for Git.
aiSuggestUses: {count, plural, =0 {Uses the staged files} one {Uses the # staged file} other {Uses the # staged files}}
aiSuggestRegion: AI draft suggestion. Tab accepts, Esc dismisses.
aiContextHint: The context size of your model, in tokens. GitOwl keeps 1,024 for the reply and a margin for estimating, so requests use about {input, number} tokens or less. Token counts are GitOwl's estimate; your model may count differently.
aiContextInvalid: Enter a whole number of tokens from {min} to {max}. The previous size is kept until then.
draftEstimate: About {estimate, number} of {limit, number} input tokens, an estimate for a {context, number}-token context. The model may count differently.
errorDraftPromptTooLong: Your commit message prompt alone needs more input than the model context allows (by GitOwl's estimate). Shorten it, or set a larger model context in AI Settings. GitOwl does not cut your prompt. Nothing was sent.
errorDraftManifestTooLarge: The list of staged files alone needs more input than the model context allows (by GitOwl's estimate). Unstage some files, or set a larger model context in AI Settings. Nothing was sent; your message is kept.
draftShortened: Shortened to fit the model context: {summary, plural, =0 {} one {# file as statistics only, } other {# files as statistics only, }}{shortened, plural, one {# file with less of its diff} other {# files with less of their diff}}. Preview what's sent shows which.
noteBudget: some changes left out to fit
noteReadLimit: only the start of its diff was read
noteManyFiles: not read: over 200 files with text changes
worktreeMainTip: The main worktree, where the repository's Git directory is.
worktreeNoFreeBranch: Every local branch is checked out in a worktree already. Create a new branch instead.
worktreeBranchesInUse: Branches checked out in another worktree are not listed: Git checks out a branch in one worktree at a time.
worktreePathHint: A new folder; GitOwl does not use one that exists. Your current worktree, its files and its staged changes stay as they are.
worktreeChooseFolder: Choose where to put the new worktree
worktreeCreatedNotOpen: The worktree was created at {path}, but GitOwl could not open it.
errorNoCommitsForWorktree: Make the first commit before creating worktrees.
errorBranchInUse: That branch is checked out in another worktree. Git checks out a branch in one worktree at a time; choose another branch or create one.
errorPathExists: Something already exists at that location. Choose a new folder; GitOwl does not overwrite it.
errorInvalidWorktreePath: Enter the full path of a new folder, starting with /.
removeWorktreeBody: GitOwl removes only a clean worktree: Git refuses one with staged, unstaged or untracked changes, and GitOwl never forces it. Branch {branch} is kept, with its commits.
pruneWorktreesBody: Pruning removes Git's records of worktrees whose folder no longer exists. It deletes no folder, keeps every branch and leaves locked records alone.
pruneWorktreesNone: There is nothing to prune: every worktree record has its folder, or is locked.
pruneWorktreesDone: {count, plural, =0 {Git pruned no records.} one {Git pruned # record.} other {Git pruned # records.}}
errorWorktreeNotFound: That worktree is no longer in the repository's list. GitOwl refreshed it.
errorRemoveMain: The main worktree holds the repository and cannot be removed.
errorRemoveCurrent: This worktree is open. Open another one before removing it.
errorWorktreeLocked: Git has this worktree locked. GitOwl does not unlock or force it; unlock it with git worktree unlock if you are sure.
errorWorktreeDirty: This worktree has staged, unstaged or untracked changes. Commit them or move them aside first; GitOwl does not remove work that is not in history.
errorWorktreeMissing: This worktree's folder no longer exists. Use Prune Missing Worktrees to remove its record.
errorBranchInWorktree: This branch is checked out in another worktree, shown below. Git keeps a branch in one worktree at a time: remove that worktree, or switch it to another branch, first.
fetchChoose: Choose a remote to fetch from
fetchCancelled: Fetch cancelled. Anything already received is kept.
errorNoRemote: This repository has no remote. Add one in Terminal with git remote add <name> <url>, then try again.
errorRemoteNotFound: That remote is no longer configured. Choose another one.
errorAuthFailed: The remote refused access, or no credentials were available. GitOwl uses your Git credential helper and SSH agent without asking for passwords; sign in once with git in Terminal, then try again.
errorHostKey: SSH could not verify the remote host. Connect once with ssh in Terminal to check and accept its key, then try again.
errorNetwork: The remote could not be reached. Check the network connection and the remote's address, then try again.
errorRemoteRepositoryMissing: The remote has no such repository, or this account cannot see it. Check the remote's URL and your access.
errorTimedOut: The remote did not finish within 2 minutes. GitOwl stopped waiting and read the repository again; try again.
publishTip: {branch} has no upstream yet. Choose a remote branch to push it to and track.
publishBody: Push {branch} to a remote branch and make it the upstream, so Push and Pull use it from now on.
errorPushDetached: HEAD is not on a branch. Create or switch to a branch to push.
errorPushUnborn: This branch has no commits to push yet.
errorPushRejected: The remote branch has commits this branch does not, so nothing was pushed. Fetch and Pull them first; if the branches have diverged, integrate them in Terminal.
errorPushRemoteRejected: The remote refused the push, for the reason below. Nothing was changed there.
errorPushUncertain: The push stopped before Git reported a result, so the remote may or may not have the commits. Fetch to see where the remote branch is.
errorBranchChanged: The current branch changed outside GitOwl. GitOwl read the repository again; check the branch and try again.
pullFrom: Fast-forward to {upstream}. Never merges or rebases.
pulledToast: {count, plural, one {Pulled # commit} other {Pulled # commits}} into {branch} from {upstream}
pullCancelled: Pull cancelled. The branch was not moved; anything already fetched is kept.
addRemoteFrom: Adds a remote to this repository.
newBranchOnOriginFrom: This name becomes the remote branch on {remote}. Push creates it.
pullBehindCount: {count, plural, one {# commit behind {target}} other {# commits behind {target}}}
pushAheadCount: {count, plural, one {# commit ahead of {target}} other {# commits ahead of {target}}}
pushCancelled: Push cancelled. The remote may or may not have the commits.
errorInvalidRemoteName: That is not a valid remote name.
errorRemoteExists: A remote with that name already exists.
errorPullNoUpstream: This branch has no upstream branch on a remote. Publish it, or set one with git branch --set-upstream-to in Terminal.
errorPullDirty: Pull needs a clean working tree. Commit, discard or move the changes and untracked files first.
errorPullInProgress: A merge, rebase, cherry-pick or revert is in progress. Finish or abort it in Terminal first.
errorPullDiverged: This branch and its upstream have both moved on, so a fast-forward is not possible and nothing was changed. The fetched commits are kept; merge or rebase them in Terminal.
errorHunkStale: The file changed since its diff was shown, so nothing was staged. GitOwl read it again; choose the hunk again.
errorHunkNotFound: That hunk is no longer in the diff. Choose it again.
errorHunkFailed: Git could not apply that hunk to the staging area cleanly, so nothing was changed. Stage the whole file instead.
errorHunksUntracked: Untracked files are staged as a whole file.
errorHunksAdded: New files are staged and unstaged as a whole file.
errorHunksDeleted: Deletions are staged and unstaged as a whole file.
errorHunksRenamed: Renamed files are staged and unstaged as a whole file.
errorHunksMode: This file's mode changed too, so it is staged and unstaged as a whole file.
errorHunksSymlink: Symbolic links and type changes are staged and unstaged as a whole file.
errorHunksNoText: This change has no text hunks; stage it as a whole file.
recentNotSaved: The recent list could not be saved. It works until GitOwl quits.
landingDropHint: or drop a folder anywhere in this window
landingDropFile: Drop a folder, not a file.
landingRecentEmpty: Nothing opened yet. Repositories you open appear here.
closeRepository: Close Repository and Return to Welcome
searchPath: File or folder path in the repository
errorScopeMissing: {scope} no longer exists. Choose another branch to search.
matchCount: {count, plural, one {# matching commit} other {# matching commits}}
errorInvalidHash: A hash search needs 4 or more hexadecimal digits (0–9, a–f).
errorInvalidPath: That path is outside this repository. Type a path inside it, relative to its root.
currentVersionNote: Opens the file as it is in the working tree
settingsEditorHint: Files and worktrees open in this app. Without one, files open in their default app.
chooseEditorNotApp: Choose an application (.app) as the editor.
errorLaunchFailed: The app could not open it. Check that the app is still installed, or choose another editor in Settings.
errorFileMissing: That file is not in the working tree any more.
errorNoEditor: Choose an editor in Settings → General to open the worktree in it.
pickWorktreePlaceholder: Search worktrees by folder, branch or path
discardBody: The file goes back to its staged version, which is the last commit's when nothing of it is staged. Its unstaged edits are lost.
discardBodyStaged: The file goes back to its staged version. What is staged stays staged; only the edits made since are lost.
discardBodyDeleted: The deleted file is restored from its staged version.
discardBodyBinary: Its changes cannot be shown as text; the whole file is restored.
discardUndo: GitOwl cannot undo this. Untracked files and other worktrees are not touched.
errorDiscardStale: The file or the staging area changed since you confirmed, so nothing was discarded. Review it below and confirm again.
errorDiscardUntracked: Untracked files are not discarded by GitOwl; delete them in Finder if you no longer need them.
errorDiscardConflict: Conflicted files cannot be discarded here. Resolve the conflict in Terminal.
errorDiscardSubmodule: Nested repositories cannot be discarded here.
errorDiscardSymlink: Symbolic links and type changes cannot be discarded here.
errorDiscardRenamed: This file has a staged rename; unstage it before discarding its edits.
errorDiscardNothing: This file has no unstaged changes any more.
partialInStaged: Other changes of this file are staged
partialInUnstaged: Other changes of this file are not staged yet
hunkActionHint: Acts on hunk {index} of {count}; only the staging area changes.
diffUnifiedHint: Show the changes in one column.
diffSplitHint: Show the old and new sides side by side.
diffSplitNarrow: The window is too narrow for the Split view; it returns when the window widens.
diffWrapLinesHint: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling them sideways; the line numbers and the staged patch do not change.
commitReady: Commits only the staged files, to {branch}
amendReadyMessage: Rewords the last commit; no staged change is folded in
amendReadyStaged: {count, plural, one {Rewords the last commit and folds in # staged file} other {Rewords the last commit and folds in # staged files}}
amendUnavailable: The last commit cannot be amended.
errorAmendDetached: HEAD is not on a branch, so there is no last commit to amend. Switch to a branch first.
errorAmendUnborn: This branch has no commits yet, so there is nothing to amend.
errorAmendPushed: The upstream already has this commit (as last fetched), so amending would rewrite shared history.
errorAmendUnknown: GitOwl cannot tell whether this commit was pushed. Fetch, or set an upstream, to judge it first; remote state is as last fetched.
errorAmendNotAllowed: This commit can no longer be amended. GitOwl rechecked it; review and try again.
syncNoUpstream: {branch} is not on a remote yet
syncPullWaits: Pull waits for a clean working tree
chromeWelcomeBody: Pick a repository from the left, or open one from disk to review its changes, history and branches.
chromePinNotSaved: The pinned list could not be saved. It works until GitOwl quits.
chromePickFile: Select a file to see its diff.
mergeBody: GitOwl merges the two sides the menu named. Conflicts stay as markers on Current changes.
rebaseBody: GitOwl rebases the two sides the menu named. Conflicts stay as markers on Current changes.
branchMenuSyncOther: Check out this branch to pull or push it.
pullRequestUnavailable: GitOwl cannot open a pull request for this remote.
errorInvalidTagName: That is not a valid tag name.
errorTagExists: A tag with that name already exists.
errorTagTargetMissing: That tag has no commit to point at.
errorRefNotFound: That name is not a commit in this repository.
errorIntegrateDirty: Merge and rebase need a clean working tree. Commit, discard or move the changes first.
errorIntegrateInProgress: A merge, rebase, cherry-pick or revert is already in progress. Finish or abort it in Terminal first.
errorIntegrateDetached: HEAD is not on a branch, so there is nothing to merge into or rebase.
errorNothingToStash: Nothing to stash. There are no staged, unstaged or untracked files.
dropStashBody: This stash is removed from the list. It is not applied to the working tree.
commitInteractiveRebaseHint: This screen does not exist yet.
commitCheckoutBody: HEAD becomes detached at this commit. The current branch is not changed.
commitCherryBody: GitOwl applies this commit onto the current branch.
commitResetBody: GitOwl moves the branch and the index to this commit and keeps the working tree.
commitRevertBody: GitOwl adds a reverse commit on the current branch. There is no message editor.
paletteCommit: {count, plural, one {Commit # staged file} other {Commit # staged files}}
searchEmptyHint: Type to search commits by message, hash or author.
